title: Sum of an Array
statement:
Write a function that adds up every element of an array of integers.

## Your function

```
int sum_array(const int *values, int count);
```

Return the sum of the first `count` elements of `values`.

## Watch out

- When `count` is `0` the array is empty and `values` may be `NULL`.
  Your function must return `0` without reading through the pointer.
- The test harness reads the array for you and calls your function.
  You only write `sum_array` -- do not write `main`.

tests.name: empty array
tests.description: count is 0 and values is NULL. Return 0 without dereferencing the pointer.

tests.name: sums back to zero
tests.description: A zero result must not be confused with an empty array.
